    <title>Firewall maintenance</title>
    <content type="html"><p><strong>THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Aug <var data-var='date'>30</var>, <var data-var='time'>08:00</var> - <var data-var='time'>11:00</var> UTC</strong></p> <p> <small>Aug <var data-var='date'>25</var>, <var data-var='time'>17:23</var> UTC</small><br> <strong>Scheduled</strong> - We’ll be performing scheduled firewall maintenance on a datacenter that will temporarily impact traffic to some of our endpoints, on our Cerebras Inference Cloud on August 30, 2026 between 1 AM and 4 AM PT.<br />We expect customer-visible interruption to total less than five minutes. During this period, you may see an increase in failed requests to your endpoint. As a precaution, please plan for the possibility of intermittent unavailability at any point during the 3-hour maintenance window. Requests affected by an interruption may fail or experience increased latency.<br />We recommend retrying failed requests with exponential backoff and avoiding time-sensitive batch workloads during the maintenance window.<br />If the work extends beyond the scheduled window, we’ll post an updated completion estimate. </p></content>
